Recorded as an attack confirmed by a source, damage unconfirmed - the orchestrator should NOT grade it as a confirmed-damage hard event on this evidence; it becomes one on an Aramco/energy-ministry statement or a printed loading halt. Market treated it as real: Brent +3.5% with 'traders paying for disruption cover' (PVM). The 'port-for-port' declaration plus the Jazan hit makes Red Sea export ports (Jeddah/Jazan/Yanbu) the next named targets on the same day the Gulf-side terminal was engaged - both Saudi export coasts are now under declared threat.
